notes.title: v1.1.0 Update - Steam Community Presence o(￣▽￣)d
notes.content:
Drummer Talent VR has not updated for a while, some players even wondered if we’ve given up the game. Unfortunately, it is not the case. We will add new features step by step, and keep the goals, which we mentioned in our Early Access announcement, in our mind. If you like drumming game or rhythm game, please don't hesitate to follow!

Now let's see, what are the changes of this new update?

New Tracks:
[olist]
Without You – Pop (Hard, Expert, Master)
Power Surge – Pop (Normal, Hard, Master)
Let Me Go Home – Rock (Normal, Hard, Expert)
Aggressor – Rock (Hard, Expert)
[/olist]

New Features:
[olist]
Steam Leaderboards added! Now we have not only an integrated ranking list but also ranking lists of each track.
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/2a4c11b7fc9e018e00c7e071d103c3288ee26532.png

Steam Achievement added! Now you can clearly find out if you’ve made progress or not. More achievements you’ve completed means more progress you’ve made.
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/4b2ed4e3cb5a5547e085bf4d6609a311b2188087.png

Steam Trading Cards added! As you play our game long enough, you can get cards now.


New Scene - Space Stage added! Wow, we can even play drums in the space now? How amazing! ヽ(°◇° )ノ
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/c04425b5e03cd0cfa405ee59697791488c16320d.png

Free Play Mode added. Now you can play your favorite songs’ drum cover! Plug your own foot switches to your computer and bind them to your keyboard. To get in the Free Play Mode, jump into “Track”- “Easy”- “Free Play” in the main interface.
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/65cfdda33186b56fb72372b3c539ce29d918213c.gif
(The Hi-Hat binds to “Z” key, and Kick Drum binds to “Space bar”)

Drum audios loaded from external! Now if you are not satisfied with the default audios of the drums or cymbals, you can replace them with your own audio files.
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/00828b19fd5bbfb5cf1b64c9793cfb750838298d.gif

Sound volume is relevant to your hitting power! That’s right, now you can hit the drums harder to increase the volume.
[/olist]

Optimization & Bug Fixes:
[olist]
Now you can hit the Bass Drum with drum sticks.
Now whether the game has system focus, you can play the game normally.
Now while we’re playing drums, it no longer triggers the collision event of drumsticks.
Optimized the AI logic of the paper men. Now they are less likely to act silly.
Optimized some localization descriptions. Now they are easier to read.
Optimized some scenes’ rendering efficiency. Now they render smoother than before.
Fixed one problem which causes a Miss during the process of opening and closing Hi-Hat.
Fixed the problem that the first rhythm note is 100% Miss of some tracks.
Fixed the problem that purple rhythm notes are shown in blue.
[/olist]

New features in next update (Not final version)
[olist]
New tracks
New instrument - Cowbell. 
Foot rhythm notes (Hi-Hat and Bass Drum rhythm) added into tracks. (Could be turned off if you don’t have external foot devices)
Place each drum and cymbal to the location you like by yourself.
[/olist]

notes.title: Free Key Weekend Event
notes.content:
Hi, what are you going to do on this weekend? Hang out with friends?  Watch a movie? Shopping? Or dating? Well, if you're going to play games, why not have fun in VR.

Good news is, taking part in our #Free Key Weeken# event, you can won a FREE KEY for another $19.99 VR Game -- "2017 VR"

About "2017 VR"
“2017” is an excellent VR Co-op Survival game, in which players from all over the world gather together in teams to try and hold back the zombie hordes and prevent the outbreak from spreading any further.
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/a9520e37e8be13cc6e82ddcbe73ac539ff46e3fc.png

How to Join
[olist]
Finished any track in "Hard" difficulty and get "SSS".
Take a screenshot and make sure the "Score" part is readable(as shown below).
Follow the steps in our Facebook "Free Key Weekend" event.
[/olist]
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28666979/4dc7ff7a968f31ca9928bffc4d032ce57218cf51.png

How to Win

Top 3 score holders, each get a giveaway key.
We’ll randomly choose another 3 lucky players.


Event Time
From May 19th at 00:00 AM(PT) to May 22nd at 10:00 AM(PT)

We'll announce the winners on our "Facebook Page" within 5 workdays after the event ened.

notes.title: Tell Your Friends about Us
notes.content:
Hey guys, we are calling upon you to tell your friends about us. 

It might be a little trifle for you, but it is big and meaningful to us. Telling your friends and the community about us is the best way to help promoting our game. With our game promoted, we can therefore receive enough feedbacks on our game and speed up our develop progress. 

Leave your Reviews to us, no matter they're pros or cons, we are glad to read every review.
Start new Discussions if you have any idea about improving our game, we are glad to have conversation you.
Post message about our game on your social media, we are glad if you regard us as your friend and follow us on Facebook and @Twitter.

Thank you for your supports and encouragements, we will try our best to make our game better.
